name: std::swap(std::vector)

declarations.code:
template <class T, class Alloc>

void swap(std::vector<T, Alloc> &lhs,

    std::vector<T, Alloc> &rhs)

    noexcept(/* see below */);

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::vector. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).
